interpretation: These are exact-artifact checks after a committed source correction, not reruns of the earlier artifact until pass. Every original failed or incomplete cohort remains retained.

Complete off/on native SLO and context-activity reports retain fourteen plus eight gates per mode. The separate focused cohort retains the original five alternating pairs, 200 warm requests, five c16/c64 waves, absolute/resource/refusal/strict-cleanup gates and median-of-per-run-p95 estimator.

The focused synthetic cohort explicitly selects force-mode native bytes. Its results do not qualify a no-environment automatic-mode production cohort. Installed automatic discovery and actual frozen application behavior have their own separately recorded checks.

All paired values and deltas are retained; a cohort qualifies only if every individual gate and both unchanged max(1 ms, 5%) relative gates pass. No limit, deadline, estimator or scheduling priority is changed, and no build, diagnostic or other acceptance job overlaps the timed runs.

The native/bridge/SDK observed tree remains included in resource sampling; shared pages may count more than once. Stable input hashes and the unchanged SDK are checked. These observations do not establish lower memory use, an internal tokenizer saving or a causal product speedup.

The prior cold-control +1.312 ms HTTP failure remains failed at its original artifact boundary. Avoided fallback discovery does not alone explain a changed HTTP comparison or establish a causal speedup.
Fixed local fact coverage and graph reuse are separate from model accuracy, tokens, human time, general reliability, full Desktop UI and external application/platform/release qualification.
